title: Semantic Versioning from the specification
hints: Split the text from the outside in: first everything after the first `+` (build metadata), then everything after the first `-` (pre-release), then the three numbers. A hyphen inside a pre-release identifier is then never mistaken for the start of one.
Two numeric identifiers without leading zeros compare by length first and then as text, which avoids converting arbitrarily long digit strings to numbers.
Write each precedence rule from the specification as a test before writing `compareVersions`; the specification's own chain of example versions is in the tests, and is the best check you have.
requirements: `parseVersion` accepts exactly the valid versions and fills in every part.
`compareVersions` follows every precedence rule, including the numeric versus text cases and the ignored build metadata.
`satisfies` implements each comparator, combines them with "and", and rejects malformed ranges with the documented exception.
